about_the_game:
This bundle is for players who want to go the extra mile to support the Pizza Hero dev team. It does not add any new gameplay content but includes a few fun extras:

  • 3 High resolution wallpapers (3840x2160).

  • Internal chart showing damage progression and graphs for weapons (Toppings and Sauces).

  • Internal chart showing descriptions, progressions, critical, and epic (recipe) hits for all power-ups.

  • Prize Cans content.

If you've enjoyed the game and want to help us keep creating, this is a great way to do it. We appreciate your support!

DLC Content Preview

High resolution wallpapers (3840x2160)

Charts
The first two charts are refined versions of the ones we've used to create and balance all of the power-ups, especially weapons. These are very useful tools for hardcore players to create perfect slices!

Power-Ups Chart
Descriptions and progression for all power-ups: Toppings, Spices, Sauces, Vending machine items. This shows power-up progression for level-up, critical hit, epic (recipe).

Weapons Damage Chart
Weapons (Toppings and Sauces) damage progression and chart. This shows damage progression for each of the 8 levels of each weapon, more specifically it shows damage per second, hits per second and damage per hit along with a very convenient damage growth graph. This also shows weapons specifications: Type (Ranged, Area, Ray, etc.), Properties (Pushback, Freezing, Burning, etc.) and more.

Prize Cans Content Chart
Helps to anticipate the rewards.
